meeting.title: Modal x Quarry — weekly implementation sync
meeting.summary: Weekly sync on the Modal onboarding. Reviewed warehouse connectivity blockers, agreed next steps on the usage events model, IP allowlisting, and pilot dashboard sign-off.
action_items: Theo to open PR with incremental model config for usage events by June 18
Jonas to add Quarry static IPs to warehouse network policy by June 17
Priya to circulate pilot dashboard list for guild sign-off by June 19
key_decisions: Usage events model will be incremental, partitioned by event date
meeting.notes: Modal team is moving fast; main risk is the network policy change sitting in their infra queue.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Morning everyone, let's run through the board. Priya, anything urgent before we start?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Nothing urgent. The team is happy with the explore experience so far, we just need the usage events data in.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Great. Theo, where are we on the usage events model?

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: I looked at the volumes — about forty million rows a day — so a full refresh is off the table. It needs to be incremental, partitioned by event date.

transcript.speaker: Jonas Beck
transcript.text: That matches what we do elsewhere in the project. Do you want to write that config or should we?

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: I'll take it. I'll draft the incremental model config for the usage events table and have it in a PR by Thursday the 18th.

transcript.speaker: Jonas Beck
transcript.text: Perfect, I'll review it same day.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Next blocker: the connection from our cloud is still being refused by your warehouse. Jonas, that's the network policy, right?

transcript.speaker: Jonas Beck
transcript.text: Yes, it's on me. I'll add the Quarry static IPs to our warehouse network policy — I can get that done by end of day Wednesday, June 17th.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: That unblocks the scheduled refreshes, thank you. Priya, last one is pilot scope.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Right. I have a shortlist of six dashboards but I want the analytics guild to agree on which four make the pilot. I'll circulate the pilot dashboard list to the analytics guild and get sign-off by Friday the 19th.

transcript.speaker: Theo Okonkwo
transcript.text: Six to four sounds right for a pilot.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: One more thing — at some point we should think about row-level security for the sales team, but that's not a today problem.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Agreed, let's park row-level security until after the pilot. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Jonas Beck
transcript.text: Nope, all clear on our side.

transcript.speaker: Maya Lindqvist
transcript.text: Great, short and sharp. Talk next Monday.
